a pre ferment on non sourdough is actually easier than you thought, try this recipe

3 cups warm water, 2 packs yeast, let yeast bloom 5 minutes, add 4 cups flour and mix that in,it will look like a really thick cake batter or pancake batter, this is desired, now beat it 100 strokes (i give it about 260 strokes usually) and let that rest 45 minutes, then add 1 tbsp of salt, 1/3 cup oil and blend that in, then add 3 to 4 cups flour for the knead out, the trick is to learn wet kneading, you need a dough scraper and several youtube videos to get the hand motion right, its a pull and quick flip of the wrist. once you can learn wet kneading your bread will bed more fluffy and light, even wheat breads, return to oiled bowl, let rest in the oven with the oven light as heat one hour, punch down, let rise one more hour and then roll out for loaves, bake 350 degrees for 1 hour, thats it, you will taste the difference and you won't need to slog through sourdough starters, you can taste the ferment. good luck, this was my chore as a 12 year old, to make the bread and pasta,
